description: This file defines core service management classes and macros for a plugin or component system, including ServiceAdministrator, ServiceType, SinkType, and PublishedServiceType, along with interface mapping macros.

classes.name: ServiceAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing service instances, libraries, and callbacks.

classes.name: SinkType
classes.description: Template class implementing reference counting for sink objects.

classes.name: ServiceType
classes.description: Template class managing service instances, including library locking and creation.

classes.name: PublishedMetadataType
classes.description: Template class providing metadata for published services.

classes.name: PublishedServiceType
classes.description: Template class representing a published service with creation and interface querying.

methods.name: Dropped
methods.description: Decrements service instance count and triggers callback.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a specific interface of the service.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns next service in the chain.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Queries supported interfaces based on interface ID.

methods.name: WaitReleased
methods.description: Waits until reference count drops to zero or timeout.

methods.name: Destructed
methods.description: Called before object destruction to release library.
